github_reason: No code was released with Li et al. 2025 (arXiv:2503.13530) or with the Fernando & Guitchounts residual-stream line; the task is BLME's own clean-room formulation of a quasi-Lyapunov exponent and is documented as such. Nothing to fetch.
paper_reason: Li et al. publish a quasi-Lyapunov analysis of reasoning traces, not a per-layer divergence-growth number for a base LM at a stated perturbation size, so there is no published value this can reproduce. The module's own analytic anchor does hold (a linear stack h_{l+1} = a h_l gives growth_log_ratio = (L-1) ln|a| exactly).
confounds_reason: Over 10 models at the study config: rho(growth_log_ratio, n_layers) = +0.673 -- it accumulates one term per block traversed, so a deeper model scores higher for being deeper. The depth-normalized twin OVER-corrects and flips the sign: rho(growth_rate_per_block, n_layers) = -0.648, and rho(., d_model) = -0.470. `initial_divergence` is a vocab/embedding-scale proxy at rho = -0.826 with vocab_size (range 0.00443-0.03303) and is emitted unprefixed.
defects: dtype: growth_log_ratio 2.800723 / 4.642212 / 3.102867 on the same gpt2 weights in fp32 / bf16 / fp16 (65.7% spread), with the realized perturbation identical to within 1.2%. `_meta_realized_rel_eps` passes on all three, so the guard that exists does not detect the larger of the two dtype problems, and nothing in the output records the storage dtype.

growth_rate_per_block is a WORSE depth proxy than the column it normalizes, with the sign flipped: rho -0.648 vs +0.673 with n_layers over 10 models. Dividing by n_transitions assumes the log-divergence is proportional to depth; measured, the two are anti-correlated after division.

initial_divergence carries rho -0.826 with vocab_size over 10 models and is feature-eligible and unprefixed. It is rel_eps times the mean embedding row norm, i.e. an embedding-scale readout, not a dynamical property.

NO UNCERTAINTY IS EMITTED AT ALL at num_samples=10 -- no std, no SEM, no per-sample spread -- so the reader cannot tell whether a between-model difference exceeds sampling noise. The task emits n_samples_used and nothing else about dispersion.

The default fallback dataset ('Perturbation growth probe sentence {i}.') is a set of near-identical short sentences; a run that reaches it produces a number on a degenerate corpus with nothing in the output to say so.
